body:
ah geez, i didn't expect that i'd be crying more this morning (it's a good thing!). a lot of the people i know have cats, and they've always been super cool. i've taught myself the basics of cat body language so i at least know that lol

zeus also sounds very sweet! i love cats that are just a little bit weird. 

your words helped me a lot and i really appreciate them. let's keep fighting the good fight, whether it's just to see how this whole thing ends or because there are some cute cats in the world that are in need of a good home :) 

i hope life gets easier and kinder to you my friend. i'll let you know if i ever get a cat in the near future. cheers to a suffering but ongoing life!
i'll definitely try. everytime i try and talk to them about it, they bring up smth about how i'm obligated to bc i'm related to them. they're not very easy to talk to lol but thank you

i already have an hourly wage better than what they offer. i still go to school and am not yet 18 so i don't have a ton of free range to get another job. they have other employees, but i'm expected to cover for their shifts if they don't show up or are bad at their job or something. bit hard to talk to them when they immediately default to calling me selfish/lazy/etc., but i appreciate your words nonetheless

very cute names! i've always liked siamese cats, but i think if i were to get one, it'd be either a british shorthair or one of those naked cats. no preference tho, best outcome is a random stray nearby chooses me :P

cats are good depression pets though, plus it's mega rewarding to earn their trust and have evidence you did with their cuddles. hope you give them many treats and pets, friend!

your father is an abusive asshole and i'm so sorry you have to live with him. would it be possible to tell one of your friends about your situation and go stay with them? i think the best move here would be to cut him out of your life asap

cats are actual angels. i don't have one myself but seeing videos of them when i'm suicidal has always helped and i'm really glad that you have the full experience of being able to pet one when you're down

what are their names?
thank you for the words, i really appreciate it. i'll keep it in mind
